006package dev.metaschema.core.datatype.markup;
007
008import dev.metaschema.core.datatype.AbstractDataTypeProvider;
009import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
010import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IMarkupItem;
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IAtomicOrUnionType;
012import dev.metaschema.core.qname.EQNameFactory;
013import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
014
015/**
016 * Provides for runtime discovery of built-in implementations of the markup
017 * Metaschema data types.
018 */
019public final class MarkupDataTypeProvider
020    extends AbstractDataTypeProvider {
021  /**
022   * The Metaschema <a href=
023   * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#markup-line">markup-line</a>
024   * data type instance.
025   */
026  @NonNull
027  public static final MarkupLineAdapter MARKUP_LINE = new MarkupLineAdapter();
028  /**
029   * The Metaschema <a href=
030   * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#markup-multiline">markup-multiline</a>
031   * data type instance.
032   */
033  @NonNull
034  public static final MarkupMultilineAdapter MARKUP_MULTILINE = new MarkupMultilineAdapter();
035
036  /**
037   * The Metaschema data type that represents all markup types.
038   */
039  @NonNull
040  public static final IAtomicOrUnionType<IMarkupItem> MARKUP_TYPE
041      = IAtomicOrUnionType.of(
042          IMarkupItem.class,
043          IMarkupItem::cast,
044          EQNameFactory.instance().newQName(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH, "markup"));
045
046  /**
047   * Create the data type provider.
048   */
049  public MarkupDataTypeProvider() {
050    register(MARKUP_LINE);
051    register(MARKUP_MULTILINE);
052
053    // register abstract types
054    register(MARKUP_TYPE);
055  }
056}
